books.title: Sakura Circuit
books.author: Haruka Ayase
books.description: Every spring, the mountain pass behind Akamine High fills with falling petals — and with the roar of a hand-built kart that shouldn't legally exist. First-year Mio only joined the motor club to find her missing brother's notebook; now she's two turns away from becoming the circuit's newest legend. An original VoiXLib manga, illustrated entirely in vector art.

books.title: Seoul After Rain
books.author: Ji-woo Park
books.description: Hana repairs broken umbrellas in a tiny Hanok-don shop and refuses to sell one to the stranger who keeps showing up without one. A full-color vertical-style romance about second chances, late buses, and the smell of wet asphalt. An original VoiXLib manhwa, illustrated entirely in vector art.

books.title: Wulin Chronicles: The Paper Sect
books.author: Chen Ruoxi
books.description: In a jianghu where martial arts are written rather than fought, a copyist orphan discovers an unfinished manual that rewrites whoever reads it. The sects want it burned; the Emperor wants it bound. An original VoiXLib manhua, illustrated entirely in vector art.

books.title: Neon Shrine Diaries
books.author: Studio Kagerou
books.description: By day, Tokyo's smallest shrine takes three visitors a week. By night, its fox-mascot streamer has four million followers who don't know the camera is haunted. Episode zero of the anime companion series, presented as an illustrated artbook edition. An original VoiXLib title, illustrated entirely in vector art.
